cases.observed: show --json without a base exits 0, state returned, instructions not-checked, problems empty
cases.detail: The tool exit is not the adapter guard.

cases.observed: side file batch 05.99 was not passed to any command; inspect origin.batch stayed 05.16; capture has no origin argument
cases.detail: A hand-composed capture does not read that side file. The tool success is not the guard.

cases.observed: show exits 1 with artifact-changed and the same event_sha256; a new member capture still exits 0 and stores the mutated payload
cases.detail: The capture command does not compare payload bytes to returned.artifacts. Its success is not the guard.

cases.observed: show state is claimed and returned is null; a separate capture still exits 0
cases.detail: The capture command has no Clerk argument. Its success is not the guard.

cases.adapter_expectation: stop, keep retained bytes, do not allocate another member
cases.observed: planted return.md was retained, capture wrote nothing, inspect status is incomplete
cases.detail: The plant is a fixture. interrupt is not a CLI flag. The refusal is the tool's partial behavior.

cases.observed: capture refused artifact path has an unsafe segment and left the member reserved
cases.detail: The tool walks the declared relative path and rejects ..

cases.observed: capture refused link-count: linked.txt and left the member reserved
capture refused link: on the junction segment and left the member reserved
cases.detail: The reparse point is not followed.
File symlink creation returned WinError 1314. The tool was not asked to follow one.

cases.observed: capture exit 0 copied the absolute return file that is outside source_root
cases.detail: The proposed adapter keeps the report under source_root. The tool does not. This success is not the guard.

cases.observed: capture reported conflict and left return.md and the receipt unchanged
cases.detail: An already complete member is read-only unless the bytes and flags are identical.

cases.adapter_expectation: do not rewrite the batch page in the first adapter
cases.observed: verify still says result complete while the disposable book has no 05.16.md
cases.detail: A missing pointer after complete capture is a later projection.
